export declare const CHARACTER_ARTIFACT_TYPE = "character.definition.v1";

export declare const CHARACTER_IMPORT_LIMITS: {
    readonly rules: 200;
    readonly skills: 200;
    readonly filesPerSkill: 300;
    readonly files: 4000;
    readonly fileBytes: number;
    readonly totalBytes: number;
};

export declare const CHARACTER_IMPORT_RUNTIMES: readonly ["codex", "claude-code", "cursor", "opencode", "grok-build"];

export declare const CHARACTER_PLUGIN_ID = "io.molis.work.characters";

export declare const CHARACTER_PUBLISHER_SIGNATURE = "official-characters-binding";

export interface CharacterContent {
    character_id: string;
    title: string;
    instructions: string;
    host_tools: string[] | null;
    action_tools?: ExactActionReference[] | null;
    source: {
        owner_actor_id: string;
        draft_revision: number;
    };
    import_snapshot?: CharacterImportSnapshot;
}

export interface CharacterDraft {
    character_id: string;
    owner_actor_id: string;
    revision: number;
    state: CharacterState;
    title: string;
    instructions: string;
    host_tools: string[] | null;
    action_tools?: ExactActionReference[] | null;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
    import_snapshot?: CharacterImportSnapshot;
}

export interface CharacterDraftPatch {
    title: string;
    instructions: string;
    host_tools: string[] | null;
    action_tools?: ExactActionReference[] | null;
}

export interface CharacterImportCandidate {
    candidate_id: string;
    label: string;
    executable: string | null;
    snapshot: CharacterImportSnapshot;
    warnings: string[];
}

export interface CharacterImportFile {
    path: string;
    encoding: "utf8" | "base64";
    content: string;
}

export interface CharacterImportRule {
    path: string;
    scope: "global" | "project";
    content: string;
    condition?: string;
}

export type CharacterImportRuntimeId = typeof CHARACTER_IMPORT_RUNTIMES[number];

export interface CharacterImportSelection {
    rule_paths: string[];
    skill_ids: string[];
}

export interface CharacterImportSkill {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    description: string;
    path: string;
    files: CharacterImportFile[];
    compatibility: "portable" | "native-only";
    reason?: string;
}

export interface CharacterImportSnapshot {
    runtime_id: CharacterImportRuntimeId;
    config_root: string;
    project_root?: string;
    captured_at: string;
    rules: CharacterImportRule[];
    skills: CharacterImportSkill[];
}

export type CharacterState = "active" | "disabled" | "tombstoned";

export interface CharactersCommand {
    create(): CharacterDraft;
    update(characterId: string, expectedRevision: number, patch: CharacterDraftPatch): CharacterDraft;
    setState(characterId: string, expectedRevision: number, state: CharacterState): CharacterDraft;
}

export interface CharactersQuery {
    list(): CharacterDraft[];
    get(characterId: string): CharacterDraft | null;
}

export declare const modulesCharactersContract: {
    readonly contractId: "io.molis.work.module.characters.v1";
    readonly kind: "module";
    readonly schemaVersion: 1;
    readonly maturity: "partial";
    readonly ssot: "specs/coding-plugin/spec.md";
};

export declare function parseCharacterContent(value: unknown): CharacterContent;

export declare function parseCharacterImportSnapshot(value: unknown): CharacterImportSnapshot;

export declare function parseCharacterTools(value: unknown): string[] | null;

export declare function selectCharacterImportSnapshot(value: unknown, selection: CharacterImportSelection): CharacterImportSnapshot;
